keepfilters_in_values.new:
measure 'Sitemap Pages #' =
			CALCULATE(
			    DISTINCTCOUNT('Sitemap'[landing_page_x_id]),
			    KEEPFILTERS(Sitemap[landing_page_x_id] IN VALUES('Queries Organic'[landing_page_x_id])))

in_calculatetable_values.new:
measure 'Sitemap Pages #' =
			CALCULATE(
			    DISTINCTCOUNT('Sitemap'[landing_page_x_id]),
			    KEEPFILTERS('Sitemap'[landing_page_x_id] IN CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Queries Organic'[landing_page_x_id]), 'Queries Organic')))

same_table_case_insensitive.new:
measure 'Sitemap Pages #' =
			CALCULATE(
			    DISTINCTCOUNT('Sitemap'[landing_page_x_id]),
			    KEEPFILTERS('Sitemap'[landing_page_x_id] IN VALUES('sitemap'[landing_page_x_id])))

unlisted_key.new:
measure 'Sitemap Pages #' =
			CALCULATE(
			    DISTINCTCOUNT('Sitemap'[url]),
			    KEEPFILTERS('Sitemap'[account_x_id] IN VALUES('Queries Organic'[account_x_id])))

url_set_algebra.new:
measure 'Sitemap Pages #' =
			VAR SitemapUrls =
			    CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('_Landing Pages'[Landing Page]), 'Sitemap')
			VAR QueryUrls =
			    CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('_Landing Pages'[Landing Page]), 'Queries Organic')
			RETURN
			    COUNTROWS(INTERSECT(SitemapUrls, QueryUrls))
